title: RMCL Launches Online Member Services
excerpt: Members can now apply for accounts, loans, and access statements digitally — available 24/7 from any device.
content: Royal Multipurpose Cooperative Society Ltd. is pleased to announce the launch of its online member services portal. Members can now register, apply for products, view account statements, and download documents from the comfort of their homes. The portal is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

title: Royal Agriculture Resource Center Opens in Tokha
excerpt: A dedicated agro-resource center to support cooperative members with farming inputs, advisory, and financing.
content: RMCL has inaugurated a new Agriculture Resource Center in Tokha to better serve its farming members in the area. The center provides agricultural advisory services, input supply linkages, and direct access to RMCL's agriculture loan products.

title: New Interest Rate Schedule – Poush 2081
excerpt: Updated lending and deposit rates for all products are now in effect. Download the full rate sheet below.
content: RMCL hereby notifies all members and stakeholders that revised interest rates for lending and deposit products are effective from Poush 1, 2081 (B.S.). Members are encouraged to visit any branch or contact the head office for detailed information.

title: Celebrating 27 Years of Excellence
excerpt: RMCL marks its 27th anniversary with a commitment to serving communities across Kathmandu and Nepal.
content: On April 22, 2025, Royal Multipurpose Cooperative Society Ltd. celebrated its 27th founding anniversary. The occasion was marked with a special program at the Head Office in Basundhara, attended by board members, staff, and long-standing members of the cooperative.
